subtitle: 엄마와의 대화 — "엄마는 이미 그런 사람이에요!"
passage: Later, Mom came home from work.
I’m not going to be anything in the future.”
And she’s only three!” I cried.
I don’t know my dream job.”
But you’re a grown-up, and you have a job,” I said.
You have the answers to everything,” I went on.
“You’re always nice, and you’re not afraid of anything.
Most of all, you’re my mom!”
Mom smiled and said, “I hope you are right.
I wanted to become that kind of person.”
You’re already that kind of person!”
Just then, I had an idea.
